entry_state: A historical journal does not identify every contract or scenario response. The product must preserve evidence, compatible histories and conditional results; the next company case must demonstrate this complete chain without inventing facts.
exit_state: Northstar connects movements, corrected statements, conditional futures and reproducible operations without identifying hidden debt terms. The next case introduces a parent and subsidiary whose shared cash, tax and ownership must survive one combined close.
findings: Northstar states its synthetic scope, unit costs, half-year accrual convention and tax simplification before the financial results. The three movement bridges recover aggregates without recovering individual invoices.

Annual profit29.6, operating cash45.6, closing cash74.6 and equity90.6 reconcile to the stated movements. The corrected interim and annual vintages are kept distinct from publication and ingestion dates.
The scenario keeps the same debt share across cash, profit and equity; separate extrema would describe no feasible company. The 7% and9% rate checks identify the required slope change.

The reproducibility discussion moves from physical inventory consistency to atomic delivery, partial information and uncertain acknowledgement. It reserves durability for actual fault testing. Section2.7 starts a separately scoped group example. No new confirmed defect in the inspected pages.
